agent_readiness.notes: robots.txt is the same stock template as other Sesame sites (disallows only /ckeditor, /ckfinder, /domains, /site_template), so all AI crawlers are allowed. Findable is decent: three complete office addresses, phone numbers, awards and 48 reviews. Answerable is weak: no hours text on the pages I opened and no JSON-LD of any kind. Bookable: the request form has labelled fields, an SMS opt-in checkbox, a real Submit button and no CAPTCHA - but no calendar and no third-party booking integration, so nothing can be confirmed without a human.

operations_signals.signal: Post-appointment survey page exists, showing the practice already automates follow-up and could extend that to review requests
Three locations with three phone numbers and one central request form with no location choice, so staff must route every enquiry by hand
SMS opt-in consent language on the form means texting is already approved for confirmations and reminders

top_opportunities.opportunity: Turn 'Schedule Now' into real per-location online scheduling with automatic confirmations, using the SMS opt-in already collected
top_opportunities.evidence: Header CTA reads 'Schedule Now' but lands on a generic request form with no location or slot selection

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add LocalBusiness schema for each of the three offices and publish hours as text on every location page
top_opportunities.evidence: No JSON-LD found on the site; no hours found on the East Brunswick location page

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add an automated review-request flow to grow the 48-review count toward the 300+ that local competitors carry
top_opportunities.evidence: Review count (48) is far below Dr. Karlin's 947 and Dr. Fleer's 321 for the same town and specialty

scores.reasons: Three-office orthodontic group with a clean modern site but no hours, no schema and a fake 'Schedule Now' - clear, well-evidenced gaps; orthodontic case values plus a multi-location footprint suggest healthy budget.
